title: 第一卷 第5章 你的金手指是什么？
content_zh:
紫府境啊。

    那可是号称真人。

    紫府真人！

    听着就威风。

    陈渊知晓这修行境界的尊称。

    灵窍境为小修士。

    法体境为大修士。

    黄庭境为道人。

    紫府境为真人。

    在这穷乡僻壤的地方，出现一位紫府真人？

    那还了得？

    看来，青山村也不能久留了。

    陈渊心中暗自思忖。

    “你是这里的村民？”

    这时，那少女忽然对着陈渊开口。

    陈渊看向她，微微颔首。

    “啊，对了，阿渊，这是我的救命恩人，叫陈昭宁。”

    李伟这才反应过来，连忙指着少女，满脸感激的道，“是她救了我。”

    陈渊看向陈昭宁，警惕道：“区区灵窍境修士，能从黑山姥姥眼皮底下把你救出来？”

    此话一出，陈昭宁神色愈发警惕，手中长刀依旧紧握：“你也是修士？”

    她扫了一眼村落，疑惑开口，“这里竟然还有修士？”

    陈渊没有理会她，而是看向李伟。

    “这一切说来话长，阿渊，有没有吃的？”

    李伟咽了咽口水，嘴唇苍白地问道。

    陈渊再次看了眼陈昭宁。

    “我保证，她绝对是好人！”

    李伟拍着胸脯道。

    他似乎极其信任那少女。

    “好，我信你，跟我来。”

    陈渊点头，将两人带回了住处。

    “阿渊哥，谁呀？”

    糯米睡眼惺忪，揉着眼睛从自己房间走出。

    她裹着一件破旧的花棉袄，疑惑地看向李伟和陈昭宁。

    “哇，好漂亮的大姐姐。”

    她眼睛瞬间亮了起来，又看向李伟，“好可爱的大哥哥。”

    李伟：“？？？”

    被人说可爱，他还是头一回。

    他立刻露出讨好的笑容：“我叫李伟，小妹妹，你叫什么呀？”

    “我叫糯米。”

    糯米脆生生地应道，下意识看了眼陈渊。

    “他是我的发小。”

    陈渊道。

    “发小是什么？”

    糯米眨巴着大眼睛，好奇问道。

    “嗯，就是从小一起长大的兄弟。”

    陈渊说完，便往灶房去看还有没有吃的。

    糯米见状，也连忙给两人倒了杯水。

    李伟和陈昭宁大口喝下，脸色才舒缓了不少。

    接下来，陈渊一边煮粥，一边和李伟有一搭没一搭地聊着，询问对方是如何来到这个世界的？

    原来，在李伟模糊的记忆里，他好像是被一个叫无相门的官方势力，从神魔遗迹里挖出来的。

    当时无相门将他当成上古遗种，进行了各种试验。

    比如灌入各种兽血神药。

    后来，李伟承受不住，死了，便被无相门送给黑山姥姥当祭品。

    没想到，李伟竟死而复生。
content_en:
The Purple Mansion Realm.

    That's a so-called real person.

    Master Zifu!

    It sounds majestic.

    Chen Yuan knew the honorific title of this realm of cultivation.

    In the spiritual orifice realm, he is a minor monk.

    Dharma body realm is a great monk.

    Huang Tingjing is a Taoist.

    The Purple Mansion Realm is a real person.

    In this remote place, a real person from Zifu appears?

    Is that okay?

    It seems that Qingshan Village cannot stay for long.

    Chen Yuan thought secretly in his heart.

    "Are you a villager here?"

    At this time, the girl suddenly spoke to Chen Yuan.

    Chen Yuan looked at her and nodded slightly.

    "Ah, by the way, A Yuan, this is my savior, his name is Chen Zhaoning."

    Only then did Li Wei react. He pointed at the girl and said gratefully, "She saved me."

    Chen Yuan looked at Chen Zhaoning and said warily: "Can a mere spiritual orifice monk rescue you from under the nose of Grandma Heishan?"

    As soon as these words came out, Chen Zhaoning's expression became more vigilant, and he still held the long knife tightly in his hand: "Are you also a monk?"

    She glanced at the village and asked in confusion, "There are actually monks here?"

    Chen Yuan ignored her and looked at Li Wei.

    "It's a long story. Ayuan, do you have anything to eat?"

    Li Wei swallowed and asked with pale lips.

    Chen Yuan glanced at Chen Zhaoning again.

    "I promise, she is definitely a good person!"

    Li Wei patted his chest and said.

    He seemed to trust the girl very much.

    "Okay, I believe you, come with me."

    Chen Yuan nodded and took the two of them back to their residence.

    "Brother Ayuan, who is it?"

    Nuomi was sleepy and walked out of her room, rubbing her eyes.

    She was wrapped in a shabby floral cotton-padded jacket and looked at Li Wei and Chen Zhaoning doubtfully.

    "Wow, what a beautiful big sister."

    Her eyes lit up instantly and she looked at Li Wei again, "What a cute big brother."

    Li Wei: "???"

    This was the first time for him to be called cute.

    He immediately showed a flattering smile: "My name is Li Wei, little sister, what is your name?"

    "My name is Nuomi."

    Nuomi crisply responded and glanced at Chen Yuan subconsciously.

    "He is my childhood friend."

    Chen Yuan said.

    "What is faxiao?"

    Nuomi blinked her big eyes and asked curiously.

    "Well, they are brothers who grew up together."

    After Chen Yuan finished speaking, he went to the kitchen to see if there was anything to eat.

    Seeing this, Nuomi quickly poured a glass of water for the two of them.

    Li Wei and Chen Zhaoning drank it in large gulps, and their expressions relaxed a lot.

    Next, while Chen Yuan was cooking porridge, he chatted with Li Wei, asking each other how he came to this world.

    It turned out that in Li Wei's vague memory, he seemed to have been dug out of the ruins of gods and demons by an official force called Wuxiang Sect.

    At that time, the Wuxiang Sect regarded him as an ancient relic and conducted various experiments.

    For example, pouring in various animal blood magical medicines.

    Later, Li Wei couldn't bear it anymore and died, so he was given to Grandma Heishan by the Wuxiang Sect as a sacrifice.

    Unexpectedly, Li Wei came back from the dead.
